output.question: Who owns Raycon?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Raycon is a privately held company controlled by co-founder and CEO Ray Lee together with company management; the exact ownership percentages are not publicly disclosed. Co-founder Ray J no longer owns Raycon: Raycon announced on March 6, 2024 that he fully divested his shares in a company buyback and stepped away as an officer and shareholder. [Raycon/PRNewswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/raycon-announces-ray-j-exit-302082164.html) [Revenue Memo](https://www.revenuememo.com/p/who-owns-raycon)
